description_en: Queries the details of an alert template by calling the DescribeMetricRuleTemplateAttribute operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeMetricRuleTemplateAttribute接口查询报警模板详情
name: DescribeMetricRuleTemplateAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The name of the alert template. You must set either `Name` or `TemplateId`.

For information about how to obtain the alert template name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114982.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警模板名称。`Name`和`TemplateId`必须设置一个。

关于如何获取报警模板名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114982.html
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert template. You must set either `Name` or `TemplateId`.

For information about how to obtain the alert template ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114982.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警模板ID。`Name`和`TemplateId`必须设置一个。

关于如何获取报警模板ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114982.html
parameters.name: template_id

The HTTP status code.

The value 200 indicates success

Category.description_en: The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name

Critical.description_en: The conditions that trigger Critical-level alerts

ComparisonOperator.description_en:
The comparison operator for Critical-level alerts. Valid values:

GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold: greater than or equal to
GreaterThanThreshold: greater than
LessThanOrEqualToThreshold: less than or equal to
LessThanThreshold: less than
NotEqualToThreshold: not equal to
GreaterThanYesterday: greater than the value at the same time yesterday
LessThanYesterday: less than the value at the same time yesterday
GreaterThanLastWeek: greater than the value at the same time last week
LessThanLastWeek: less than the value at the same time last week
GreaterThanLastPeriod: greater than the value in the last period
LessThanLastPeriod: less than the value in the last period
ComparisonOperator.description_zh:
Critical级别的阈值比较符。取值：

GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold：大于等于。
GreaterThanThreshold：大于。
LessThanOrEqualToThreshold：小于等于。
LessThanThreshold：小于。
NotEqualToThreshold：不等于。
GreaterThanYesterday：同比昨天时间上涨。
LessThanYesterday：同比昨天时间下降。
GreaterThanLastWeek：同比上周同一时间上涨。
LessThanLastWeek：同比上周同一时间下降。
GreaterThanLastPeriod：环比上周期上涨。
LessThanLastPeriod：环比上周期下降

Statistics.description_en:
The statistical method for Critical-level alerts.

The valid values of `Statistics` vary based on the Alibaba Cloud service. For more information, see [Alibaba Cloud service metrics]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html）
Statistics.description_zh:
Critical级别的统计方法。

每个云服务的`Statistics`取值不同。更多信息，请参见[云服务监控项]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html）
